--- ## Walkthrough This PR removes explicit upstream mock KMS plugin deployment calls from two e2e tests; both tests now proceed directly to client retrieval, namespace creation, and their existing encryption on/off and provider migration assertions unchanged. ## Changes **KMS test updates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Remove manual KMS plugin deployment in on/off**
`test/e2e-encryption-kms/encryption_kms.go`|Removed the explicit `librarykms.DeployUpstreamMockKMSPlugin` call from `testKMSEncryptionOnOff`; the test proceeds to client retrieval, namespace creation, and on/off encryption assertions.| |**Remove manual KMS plugin deployment in migration**
`test/e2e-encryption-kms/encryption_kms.go`|Removed the explicit `librarykms.DeployUpstreamMockKMSPlugin` call from `testKMSEncryptionProvidersMigration`; the test proceeds to client retrieval, namespace creation, and provider migration assertions.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - [openshift/cluster-openshift-apiserver-operator#693](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-openshift-apiserver-operator/pull/693): Overlaps on KMS provider and mock/plugin configuration changes in the same test file. ## Suggested labels `lgtm`, `verified` ## Suggested reviewers - sanchezl
